name: brush-wasm-dev
description: Development scripts for the wasm binding. The published package is generated by wasm-pack into pkg/.

scripts.types: json2ts --input ../../spec/ops.schema.json --output types/ops.d.ts --bannerComment "/* Generated from spec/ops.schema.json by json-schema-to-typescript. Do not edit; run npm run types. */" --additionalProperties false
scripts.build: npm run types && wasm-pack build --target web --release
